fair_value.method: Sum of parts on ~3.5B diluted shares, 12m forward: core auto+services at ~30x 2027E consensus EPS of $2.17 (~$70/sh); energy ~$13-14B revenue at low-20s% GM, ~$2B EBIT x 27 (~$16/sh); net cash ~$40B plus SpaceX stake (~$15/sh); probability-weighted autonomy (FSD subscriptions + robotaxi/Cybercab, ~$550B, ~$160/sh) and Optimus option (~$270B, ~$80/sh). Total ~$340; the stock is ~85% option value, so this is a judgment anchor rather than a cash-flow floor.

bear.story: Capex >$25B keeps FCF negative, operating margin stays ~1-4%, Q3/Q4 deliveries slip (consensus ~461k Q3 vs Goldman 435k), robotaxi remains a few hundred vehicles in Texas/Florida, FSD v15 slips into mid-2027, EU approval delayed; multiple compresses toward ~100x a ~$2 EPS stream plus modest option value.

base.story: Revenue grows low-teens, non-GAAP EPS ~$2.2 in 2027, energy recovers toward mid-20s margins, robotaxi expands to ~a dozen metros with Cybercab ramp slow but visible, EU FSD Supervised approved; story-driven multiple holds and stock ends near today's level/analyst median (~$400) range.

bull.story: Unsupervised FSD on customer cars / v15 validated, Cybercab fleet scales into thousands with credible unit economics, Optimus external units and Semi volume ramp, plus SpaceX-merger/AI narrative re-rating; stock retakes and exceeds the $499 high.

thesis_break_reason: About 15% below the July 2026 capitulation low ($297-304) that already priced a negative-FCF quarter and 1.4% operating margin. Trading at ~$255 would most likely mean the autonomy thesis broke (serious robotaxi safety incident/regulatory halt, v15 failure) or the core business turned loss-making with cash burn eroding the ~$43B cash pile, rather than ordinary 46%-vol noise.

catalysts.event: EU TCMV vote on EU-wide FSD Supervised approval (may slip to 2027)
Q3 2026 earnings: margins, capex path, FCF, Cybercab/Optimus updates
Musk-promised unsupervised FSD on customer vehicles / robotaxi in ~12 states by year-end; FSD v15 release
Q4 2026 deliveries and FY26 earnings with 2027 capex guidance
Annual meeting; Optimus production ramp disclosures; possible SpaceX-Tesla combination talk

key_uncertainties: Pace and safety of robotaxi scaling beyond ~400 registered AVs in Texas/Florida; FSD v15 validation timing
Duration of negative FCF from a $25B+ capex cycle rising further into 2027
Core auto margins (auto GM ex-credits 16.3%, operating margin 1.4% in Q2) and collapsing regulatory credits
Energy margin recovery after Q2 warranty charge (20.4% GM) and low-cost competition
Optimus commercial timeline (no unit counts disclosed yet)
SpaceX merger/dilution speculation and capital rotation into SpaceX post-IPO
Key-person/governance risk around Musk and his 2025 performance award
reasoning: Evidence: Q2 2026 revenue $28.2B (+26%) and record ~480k deliveries, but non-GAAP EPS $0.33 missed (~$0.53 est), op margin 1.4%, FCF -$1.1B on $5.8B capex, with 2026 capex guided >$25B and rising; stock fell 26% in July to ~$304 then recovered to $372. Consensus 2026/2027 EPS ~$1.77/$2.17 (~170x 2027), so the price is overwhelmingly option value on autonomy/Optimus. Autonomy is progressing but slowly (six metros, ~420 AVs registered in Texas incl. 45 Cybercabs, 1M unsupervised miles, Cybercab in public fleet since Sept 4) with Musk deferring scale to FSD v15 (late 2026/early 2027). Analyst targets cluster at $397 avg/$415 median with recent bank targets $360-445 (mostly Hold). My SOTP gives ~$340, slightly below spot, but I do not expect the market to price TSLA on fundamentals alone within 12 months. Scenarios bear $225/25%, base $370/50%, bull $580/25% give mean ~$386 and median ~$360. Ladder is a lognormal with median $360 and sigma 0.48 (slightly above the 46% realized vol given binary autonomy catalysts and negative FCF), with a slightly fattened lower tail; P(>=372) = 0.47, P(>=502) = 0.24, P(<223) = 0.17. Independent of options data; research relied on web search of press/filings summaries (Q2 IR deck not read in full).
